headline: You’re seeing a costly pattern after losses.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The pattern cost you ₹1,05,732 and was seen in 96 trades where after a loss you entered with a median size of ₹12,562 versus your usual median size of ₹6,578, a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375 and had a win rate of 28%, while your other trades posted a win rate of 39%.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is starting to show up and is worth keeping an eye on.

closing: Consider applying the rule “After a loss, your next entry is your usual size” next month.
